items.title: Qwen2.5-1.5B Instruct / 28L LUT4, production ANEMLL Core ML conversion
items.limitation: The 79 CPU operations are the lm_head argmax tail. By assigned operations, that’s 96.4% ANE and 3.6% CPU.

items.title: Qwen2.5-1.5B / KV state path
items.limitation: June infer function: 56 slice_update, 57 read_state, 56 write_state and 225 slice_by_index, all on ANE. In the shipped prefill function, one read_state is assigned to the CPU (56 ANE / 1 CPU).

items.title: Qwen2.5 / decode batch sweep
items.limitation: Five-round, interleaved, steady-state run on a single-function, batch-shaped probe. Throughput only. Output quality wasn’t validated. A later perplexity check on the B=4 probe, dated 3 July 2026, found its output logits roughly 1000 times larger than the B=1 model’s. The repository’s current records don’t resolve that (N/003).

items.title: Qwen2.5 / LUT4 model quality
items.limitation: A hand-written 28L quantized model, run as two 14L halves that share KV, with position-correct RoPE. Full 12,000-token validation set.

items.limitation: LFM2.5-1.2B layer slices meet a strict ANE parity gate. The 16-layer chain and token logits miss it.

items.title: Did either graft pay off?
items.limitation: Both grafts passed their numerical checks. In the timed build, an EAGLE draft head made every call slower, and it has to earn that back.

items.title: Published Qwen2.5-1.5B Core ML package: greedy output depends on the compute unit, and cpuOnly returns NaN
